payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'dreaming'. services.md would put the magazine first for early-stage readers, but the brief's goal sets Wedded Concierge as primary with the magazine as the early-stage magnet, and the reader (AUD 150k+, wants a plain list of what to ask a venue) is acting on the questions; the magnet already sits before the planning section for the reader still at the ideas stage. Targets /wonderland-concierge (default commercial CTA target) and /magazine both confirmed in link-map.csv. All four links already exist in 08-final.md with correct UTMs, primary before secondary, anchor exactly 'Wedded Concierge'; nothing is added, moved or rewritten. Panel cta_reactions are 'maybe' from planner_couple, funding_parent, sceptic and uhnw and 'no' from search_visitor (ideas stage, served by the magnet). The panel's earlier fixes are already in the copy: the mid-page line leads with venue visits (sceptic), and the closing ask invites anything that needs to stay private (uhnw) as an ask, not a promise. What readers said they would want to see before clicking (sceptic: fee model and supplier commissions; funding_parent: deposits, a first phone call, who to contact on the day, who the Advisor is; planner_couple: who is on the ground; uhnw: scale and confidentiality) cannot be answered in the post without business facts that brand-facts lists as deferred, so it belongs on /wonderland-concierge and is logged for the run report, not added here. Possible lead magnet, not placed (exists: false, nothing on the site yet): a printable garden venue question checklist built from 'What to plan for with your venue' and 'Destination garden weddings'; it would suit the dreaming reader better than a general magazine and give the sceptic a reason to stay. Subtexts are for a CMS button if one is used and use brand-facts 'Claims we can make' wording only (one Wedded Advisor, start to finish, as a single point of contact; inclusions confirmed in writing before you commit). The magnet is described without the word 'free'.
